messages:
Priya: Heads-up — planning schema fanout + small backfill tonight. Target quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback readiness. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/schema-fanout

Jun: I can own the deploy and the rollback path. I'll be online from 01:45 UTC. Will run the preflight script and watch replica lag.

Maya: I'll run smoke tests and validate API responses after cut. My checklist: :white_check_mark: create user flow, :white_check_mark: read profile, :white_check_mark: search indexing sample. I'll paste the smoke commands into the runbook before handoff.

Samir: Quick Q — are we doing a mirror-write (dual-write) toggle or full cutover? Also how are we throttling the backfill?

Priya: We'll mirror-write for 60m after the fanout, then evaluate error rates. Backfill will be chunked with a rate limiter (500 rows/sec) and strong idempotency. If tail latency or error rate > 1% we stop and rollback.

Diego: DB notes: I'm going to bump the connection pool for the migration and run health checks. Migration snippet (preflight):
```sql
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN last_seen_ts bigint;
-- backfill example (batched):
UPDATE profiles SET last_seen_ts = extract(epoch from last_active)::bigint WHERE last_seen_ts IS NULL LIMIT 1000;
```
I'll also monitor replica lag via psql and `pg_stat_replication`.

Jun: Preflight steps I'll run at 01:50 UTC:
- disable non-critical nightly jobs
- verify replica lag < 5s for the last 10m
- take logical backup (pg_dump schema-only)
- set feature flag to mirror-write in staging then prod

OpsBot: deploy-lock acquired for window 2026-03-17 02:00-03:30 UTC by Jun. Pager duty notified (oncall: Maya).

Maya: I'll coordinate smoke runs at +10m and +40m after the fanout starts. If anything fails I'll escalate in this thread and run rollback tests.

Samir: Who's owning the rollback script? Need explicit owner and a dry-run plan.

Jun: I own the rollback script. Dry-run will be executed in staging tonight at 23:30 UTC; commands are in the runbook under 'rollback'. Rolling back will flip feature flag -> stop mirror-write, and then run compensating backfill to revert column data where flagged.

Priya: OK — owners confirmed: Jun (deploy + rollback), Maya (smoke + on-call), Diego (DB ops & pool). Everyone: please post final ack once you've added your preflight checks to the runbook. We'll reconvene async here 01:30 UTC for last-minute sync. :thumbsup:
